caption: A vertical wooden post with a metal hook on a white surface against a pale wall suspends a transparent cup holding a white cylinder. A clear tube attached to the cup bends into a large open loop around it, one arc colored blue, and a thin skewer projects from the cup. The hanging assembly is already in continuous motion, rotating and tilting about the hook. The cup's opening shifts between tilted and more upright orientations as the skewer sweeps from down-left toward left and upward. The tube loop cycles between a wide ellipse and a narrower edge-on profile, with the blue arc traveling around its perimeter. The white cylinder stays inside, changing apparent position as the cup tilts, while motion blur appears during rapid sweeps. The post, hook and background remain fixed, so the movement belongs to the object.
